description: Requantise two signed 16-bit lanes of a by arithmetic right shift with round-to-nearest-even. Lane k amount is c[4k+:4]; c[31:8] must be zero. result=rounded lane. aux[7:0]=c[7:0] echoed, aux[9:8]=lanes whose floor quotient was incremented. fault=nonzero c[31:8], with result=aux=0.
